items.signal_prefix: Orders and customers (DART half-year report filed 08-14-2026

set.signal: Orders and customers (DART half-year report filed 08-14-2026, as of 2026-06-30): H1 2026 NEW ORDERS KRW 836,195M (147,923 m2) vs KRW 571,375M delivered (117,064 m2) - a 1.46x book-to-bill; ORDER BACKLOG KRW 622,180M (109,714 m2) at 2026-06-30, up from KRW 573.7B at 2026-03-31 (+8.4% QoQ) and equal to ~1.6x Q2 revenue. CUSTOMER CONCENTRATION: one customer (anonymised customer A) is 40.1% of consolidated H1 revenue (KRW 288,666M, up from KRW 208,600M / 42.2% a year ago); on the parent's separate books three customers exceeded 10% - A KRW 274,762M, B KRW 60,679M (up 2.5x from KRW 23,954M), C KRW 39,575M - together 57.4% of parent revenue. Filing states products go mainly to global big-tech companies - data-center, AI and network-equipment makers - sold direct (Americas direct supply), ~60-day payment after shipment. Hyperscale server market: of the CSPs holding >60% of the global data-center market the company has secured 'G' and 'M' as customers and is in talks with 'A' for new entry. AI accelerators: 'G' and 'N' are the main customers, both are expected to have the company participate in and mass-produce their NEXT-GENERATION models, and new AI-accelerator customers are being pursued, so AI-accelerator revenue is expected to keep expanding; the filing notes that 'N' dominates GPUs while 'A' and other big techs accelerate in-house AI ASICs (chiplet, 2.5D/3D packaging, HBM) - the structural driver of ultra-multilayer MLB demand. Networking: 800G switch MASS PRODUCTION has started, with switch/router bandwidth moving 400G to 800G to 1.6T. Trade receivables rose to KRW 328,977M (99.49% under 6 months).
